subject: Renewal QBR: standby rota & demo day fallback plan
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@clearex.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: ClearEx Procurement <procurement@clearex.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: QBR week — demo day timing and backup hosts

Hi Marissa / Priyom,

Thanks again for today’s pre-call. We want to lock the QBR demo window for renewal week and make sure we have a short standby plan in case our execs get pulled into conflict. Current ask: a 60-min live demo during the week of Aug 4–8, ideally in the mornings PT to fit our APAC stakeholders in the tail-end.

Two constraints from my side:
- Procurement needs the final runbook and a DocuSign-ready order by Aug 1.
- Our Head of Engineering is only available on Aug 5 morning PT; if that falls through we need a clear recorded fallback and a standby host who can run the demo.

Can you propose: 2 live slots (primary + alt) and a standby presenter rotation? Also send any runbook you reference for procurement.

Elena
Elena Torres | Senior Program Manager, ClearEx

Attachments: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Naomi Kapoor <naomi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR week — demo day timing and backup hosts

Elena — thanks, noted. Proposed plan below and I attached the runbook + a simple ops calendar so procurement can see the timeline.

Proposed live slots (PT):
- Primary: Tue Aug 5, 09:30–10:30 PT (fits Head of Eng availability)
- Alt: Thu Aug 7, 10:00–11:00 PT (fallback if exec conflict)

Standby rota (30-min prep notice):
- Day of: Priyom (primary presenter) -> Naomi (backup) -> Marissa (backup-backup)
- If the Head of Eng is unavailable we run the prioritized tech demo but open a 20-min exec Q&A via recorded answers + live moderator.

Deliverables sent:
- QBR-runbook-v2.pdf (attached) — includes run order, slide deck owners, and recording plan.
- calendar-ops-sheet.csv (attached) — proposed invite times for all timezones and acceptability windows.

Next steps:
1) Elena, confirm the two slots work for your execs.
2) If confirmed, we'll push invites and a separate recording-only fallback meeting for Aug 5 at 08:00 PT (recorded runthrough).
3) I'll route a DocuSign-ready statement of work to procurement once slots are locked.

Thanks — I’ll update the runbook with the final standby names once you confirm.

—
Marissa Cole
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0134

Attachments: QBR-runbook-v2.pdf (18 pages), calendar-ops-sheet.csv

Adding a quick ops note for the standby rota:
- We should publish a 1-page "switch-to-recording" checklist in the runbook (quick bullets: mute mics, enable recording, share deck link, open chat for async Q&A).
- Priyom: please confirm you can be primary presenter on Aug 5 and that you are comfortable running a 20-min recorded answers session if execs drop.
- Also suggest we set a 15-min pre-brief for all presenters 30 minutes before the live slot (08:45 PT on Aug 5) to validate AV and slides.

I’ve updated slide ownership in page 6 of the runbook (internal copy). I can make the one-page checklist and drop it into the shared Drive link Marissa sent.

Naomi
Ops Lead, CS Delivery | Redwood Inference

Procurement asked that the DocuSign package be visible by end-of-day Jul 25 so we can route approvals. Can you confirm the order total in the SoW will match the draft we reviewed last week?

Is it possible to add a 30-min recording-only window at 00:30 PT on Aug 6 so they can watch Q&A asynchronously? If you can record and drop the Q&A notes in the shared folder, that would be sufficient.

Appreciate it — Elena
